_leewayHeader.purpose: Declare read-only realtime observation and governed event-publish boundaries for Agent Lee.
_leewayHeader.inputs: Tenant identity, delegated user authority, operations event schema, and tool policy.
_leewayHeader.outputs: Capability metadata for retrieval and controlled tool routing.
_leewayHeader.dependencies: Operations event API, SignalR hub, Shield authorization, and LeeWay receipts.
_leewayHeader.tests: JSON parse, policy tests, tenant isolation, and architecture tests.
_leewayHeader.securityImpact: AgentService may read authorized events but cannot publish without a separate delegated mutation tool.
